title: Pedal trash-can task suite
goal: Verify pedal-driven lid opening and lid return under a bounded, non-following initial push followed by zero commanded input.

profiles.title: Pedal trash can v1
profiles.description: The historical pedal-lid profile revised to use the user-approved 60 degree opening target and a bounded world-fixed return impulse.

scenarios.title: Open and return the pedal-driven lid
execution_requirements: Execute opening and return in one continuous output-angle roundtrip.
During opening, drive the pedal linkage and measure motion at the lid output.
During at most the first 0.5 seconds of return, an optional push of no more than 6 N may be applied along a direction and line fixed in world coordinates.
The optional push direction and line of action must not be re-aimed, translated, or otherwise made to follow lid motion.
After the initial 0.5 second return interval, all commanded return assistance must remain zero.

tasks.title: Open the lid with the pedal
tasks.goal: Use the pedal linkage to open the lid to the approved minimum angle.

criteria.description: The lid reaches at least 60 degrees, with the approved 3 degree shortfall tolerance.

failure_diagnostics.description: The measured lid opening is less than the accepted 57 degree lower bound.

evidence_obligations: Preserve the physical and ideal-reference output-angle traces and the pedal actuation record.

tasks.title: Return the lid after pedal release
tasks.goal: Return the lid to its initial position using only the approved bounded initial push and subsequent zero input.

criteria.description: The final lid return error is at most 3.5 degrees.
Peak magnitude of the optional initial return push is at most 6 N.
The optional return push is active for no more than the first 0.5 seconds after release.
The optional push direction remains fixed in world coordinates and does not follow lid motion.
The optional push line of action remains fixed in world coordinates and does not translate with the lid.
All commanded return assistance remains zero after the initial 0.5 second window.

failure_diagnostics.description: The final lid angle remains more than 3.5 degrees from its initial position.
The optional initial return push exceeded 6 N.
Return assistance remained active beyond the allowed initial 0.5 second window.
The return push direction or line of action changed with lid motion instead of remaining fixed in world coordinates.
Commanded return assistance was nonzero after the initial 0.5 second window.

evidence_obligations: Preserve the complete return-phase force log with force vector, world line of action, magnitude, and time.
Preserve the physical and ideal-reference lid-angle traces through the final return sample.
Demonstrate from the actuation log that no return assistance remains after 0.5 seconds.

source_projects.note: The historical opening evidence remains relevant, but the historical return used a moving reverse assist and therefore does not certify this suite's world-fixed, time-bounded return rule.

approval.basis: The user approved a 60 degree lid opening target with 3 degrees of shortfall tolerance, a 3.5 degree return limit, and an optional world-fixed non-following push of at most 6 N for only the first 0.5 seconds followed by zero input.
